edge_explainer.market_believes: Korean banks deserve the Korea discount: structurally capped returns, and governance reform is perennial jam-tomorrow.
edge_explainer.we_believe: KB has already re-rated to ~1.0x book, so the market largely agrees with us now. What remains is a durable ~8% cash-return machine (dividend + buyback-and-cancel) with a legislated cancellation law behind it — carry, not a mispricing.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Honestly: minimal. The re-rate we might have caught is ~90% done. We hold it for the cash return, sized small.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: It essentially is — market-revealed cost of equity ≈ return on equity. The law mainly re-rates the LAGGARD banks, not the already-compliant KB.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Nothing dated — quarterly payout execution. Exit the re-rate leg above ~1.25x book.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Nothing to falsify — no mechanism claimed; exit discipline (>1.25x book) is the only trigger.
